name: leaderboard-local-declined
about: The player declined net.local and allowed net.internet; the server option is the test server on this computer (tests/board/server): the board says this mod may not reach this computer or the local network, a star's time is not sent and the line over the game says why, the server hears nothing (no request went out through net.internet in its place), and the game goes on

expect.is: This mod is not allowed to reach this computer or your local network. Allow it on the mod's page in Mods.
This star's time was not sent. This mod is not allowed to reach this computer or your local network. Allow it on the mod's page in Mods.
